xrdp optimized shared-console source provenance

Base source: xrdp v0.10.6.1, upstream commit 80c52879fead585d6347df5b3c587718adf8f5a5.
Performance work: the eight input/VNC/GFX changes from the external consultation
were integrated directly into this tree and remain opt-in where they alter
graphics flow control. The source contains the input-first scheduler and VNC
capture/encoding changes; there is no separate patch directory in this release.
Resize fix: upstream change a11ee461a70e16163f8e8e75ccd6ef876d9c99e4 (PR #3755)
was integrated into the VNC resize state machine to keep EGFX alive and reset
surfaces correctly when a client changes desktop size. This addresses the
cursor-only/black-frame behavior reported for xrdp 0.10.6.1 VNC proxy sessions.
Build profile: -O3 -march=native, one make worker, x264 enabled, strict module
locations, and /run/xrdp/sockdir for the system socket root.

The source retains the upstream Apache-2.0 notices in COPYING and the bundled
subdirectories. See docs/console-profile.md and scripts/build-optimized-xrdp.sh
for the reproducible build and activation workflow.
